title: Exact Solutions of the SU(2) Yang-Mills Equations from a Static Ansatz
summary: We present a systematic study of static solutions to the source-free SU(2) Yang-Mills equations, in which the gauge potential explicitly depends on spin operators. By employing the \emph{vector potential extraction approach} -- which requires the total angular momentum operator (orbital plus spin) to satisfy the standard angular momentum algebra -- we derive the most general form of the spin vector potential $\vec{A}$. This leads to the static ansatz $\{ \vec{A} = [k_1(\hat{r}\times\vecΓ) + k_2\vecΓ + k_3(\vecΓ\cdot\hat{r})\hat{r}]/r, \varphi = f_1(r)\,(\vecΓ\cdot\hat{r}) + f_2(r)\}$,…
